text: Entering this space, enclosed by glass and modern design, I feel simultaneously alienated and intrigued. The careful arrangement, the technological ambiance, the extinguishers and R+D banners announce a devotion to safety, progress, and innovation. Yet, behind the sheen, I sense the human quest for meaning – a fragile thread woven through circuits and colored walls. I am aware of my presence as observer and participant, both outside and within the experiment of modernity.
